embeds.title: Day 3 shipped — the game does something
embeds.description: Open Ctrl+K, type `dispatch E1 i_2031`, press Enter. E1 routes from Davenport Central to a real address on real OSM roads, arrives, engages for the resolution window, drives home. The first time the game does anything.

fields.name: Build
fields.value: tsc clean · 13/13 tests · vite 16s · 496 KB gz

fields.name: What ships
fields.value:
**Sim core** (`src/sim/`)
• Road graph from baked OSM (6-decimal node quantisation, haversine edges)
• Dijkstra shortest path on min-heap
• Pure tickStep FSM: en_route → on_scene → resolved → returning → available
• RAF tick loop: 4 real-sec = 1 game-min @ 1×, speed + pause respected

**UI wiring**
• Cmdk palette executes verbs on Enter: `dispatch`, `recall`, `pause`, `speed`, `focus`
• TopStrip: live game-min clock, pause toggle, 0.5×/1×/2×/4× speed picker
• Map: PathLayer renders active routes (amber en_route, dim returning)
• BottomTicker: latest dispatch event with T+game-min stamp

**Schema**
• Unit gets `route_progress_m` / `route_total_m` / `destination_coord` / `on_arrival` (all optional)

fields.name: Tests
fields.value: **13/13 pass.** Pathfinding (graph build, route find, disjoint→null, walkAlong). Full FSM cycle on synthetic 5-node graph. Reject-on-busy. Reject-on-no-graph.

fields.name: Day 4 next
fields.value: Ontology drill-down: hop unit → incident → caller → address → station → personnel without losing context. Selection history. Right-rail back-button. Then Day 5: cmdk verb registry + autocomplete. Day 6: Tier 1 fully playable.
